annotations.text:
One zoom control, four representations — not a scale transform.
L2 Card → L1 Grid → L0 Constellation. Both panes always move together, so "spread everything out in front of me" is one gesture.
L0 colours every card in the pool by combo degree — a heat map of where your synergies actually are. Nothing is filtered or sampled away: every candidate has a pip.
Every recommendation states its case. Kiki-Jiki's three combos share a piece and still count as three — distinct combos, per the domain rule.
Same product, not a reduced one. The deck is a bottom sheet at three detents so both regions stay on screen; swipe accepts and rejects, and every swipe has a tap equivalent in the inspect sheet.
There is no save button anywhere in this design, so switching decks never prompts. The chip in the command bar is the switcher.
